SELECT category_id, complaint_master_id, category_code, category_name, description, sort_order, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at FROM tb_complaint_category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
